description: Template.__init__ refuses a template uri that points outside the root path. Before the check it removes one leading slash from the uri, so a uri that starts with two or more slashes and then steps up with .. is normalised to an absolute-looking path and accepted. TemplateLookup strips all leading slashes when it looks for the file, so such a uri loads a file outside the template directories.

finding.message: The check that a template uri stays inside the root strips only one leading slash.
